where: A home in the City of Richmond.
split_note: Each government’s share is one slice unless it publishes a debt split.
rollback_note: Virginia requires a locality to advertise a lowered rate when reassessment raises its tax base. Richmond skipped reassessment in 2026, so no lowered rate applies to FY2027.
hearing: City Council sets the rate with the budget each spring.
limits: Richmond’s tax relief for older and disabled owners isn’t modeled.
